== Source-backed four-design chronology ==
This earlier lower-face design is supported by the complete official archived sheet. The lower-face slip visibly supplies power 1, ability 2, deploy 2, forfeit 3, Pilot/Warrior and Set2 icons, game text and “Original concept by Brian Fred”. It does not reproduce the upper card face. Destiny 2, the upper Palace Raider title/lore and Alien type are inherited from the named underlying Decipher card, verified against its unchanged original archive face [[:File:JPSD-L-palaceraider-decipher-archive.gif]]. Artwork is not reconstructed. Catalogue rarity is not independently established by this crop and is omitted from these new partial articles. No unrelated strategy or contemporary Scomp rulings are imported.

Dates are known-by bounds, not established first-publication days. The2016/2017 partial pixels are identical and count once. The current executable 202_2 remains on the2022 full face. No executable ID is created for either newly recovered partial.
